note: Machine-readable form of the palette locked by the 2026-07-12 reset in docs/art/aesthetic-direction.md. That document is the source of truth; this file exists so the pipeline can ENFORCE it. If they disagree, the markdown wins and this file is the bug.

luma_model.why: Rec.709 luma on gamma-space sRGB values. The ramp is near-neutral, so quantizing by luma distance is more predictable than RGB distance and keeps the four values evenly separated. Linear-light luminance would crush the ramp toward the dark end and misassign midtones.

demichrome-4.name: 2-bit Demichrome
demichrome-4.scope: Every sprite in the game — heroes, retinue, Still Legion, the Quiet, the Unwitnessed, UI, portraits, vignettes. No sprite may introduce a fifth value or a palette-swapped variant without an explicit owner exception.

values.name: Demichrome Dark
values.role: darkest — outline, void, recess, ground state

values.name: Demichrome Steel
values.role: dark-mid — the game's only cold/armor/shadow value

values.name: Demichrome Bone
values.role: pale-mid — the game's only warm/skin/highlight value

values.name: Demichrome Pale
values.role: brightest — the game's only bright: lamps, eyes, marks, UI

mask.note: Transparency is not a value. Alpha must be binary (0 or 255) — the material is Unlit + Masked and partial alpha is the most common silent breakage.

ascii_legend.note: The characters art specs use to draw pixel maps in markdown (the silhouette guides in docs/art/*.md). 'pixelpipe.py authored' renders such a block straight to a PNG -- so a spec's silhouette guide is not a sketch of the sprite, it IS the sprite: on-palette by construction, correctly proportioned, and costing zero generations. Keep these characters stable; changing one invalidates every existing spec.

light_shift.rule: Light is a one-value-brighter shift along this same ladder, never a new hex. dark->steel, steel->bone, bone->pale, pale->pale.

dim_shift.rule: The inverse: one value darker along the same ladder, never a new hex. Added 2026-07-25 because the flame premise needs dimming at least as often as brightening -- units outside the leash render one value down (docs/narrative/FLAME-FOUNDATION.md 3a), and a guttering flame dims the bearer itself. Both are a 4-entry value remap driven by one scalar on the Unlit+Masked material, not a second texture.

dither.rule: 2x2 blocks minimum on anything that moves; 1px halftone is reserved for static UI and portraits. 1px dither on a moving sprite shimmers at horde scale.

trial_palettes.note: Candidate ramps for the Emberkeep.Palette dial (task-043) — NOT canon. demichrome-4 above remains the locked direction; these exist so a candidate can be judged in PIE at horde density instead of on a swatch. The index here is the CVar value and must match the GSwarmPalettePresets table in Rendering/SwarmRenderActor.cpp. TO ADD ONE: append an entry here and one row there.
trial_palettes.how_to_judge: min_luma_gap is the number that matters. It is the tightest step on the ramp, and it is what carries friend/foe readability at 700 units — demichrome's 0.218 is the bar. A palette that photographs better and reads worse in a wave has lost.

entries.name: Eulbink (4-value cut)
entries.note: Cut from the 7-colour set, whose bottom three blues sit within 0.10 luma and cannot all survive as distinct values. Separates BETTER than the incumbent. Would also close open decision L11 (docs/RENDERING-LIGHTING.md:705) — the flame pool currently reads warm because it grades through Bone; a blue->white ramp gives a white pool without a palette exception. Tonally cold, for a game about carrying fire.

entries.name: Rust Gold (4-value cut)
entries.note: Cut from the 8-colour set, which CANNOT work whole under a luminance quantizer: #202020/#331c17 are luma 0.125/0.128 and #563226/#393939 are 0.223/0.224, so those pairs collapse into one bucket. The full set separates by HUE, which needs the Phase B index pipeline (task-041). This 4-cut is a proper value ramp and gives the warm tone without it.

retired_hexes.note: Hexes voided by the 2026-07-12 reset. The validator rejects any request or linked spec that cites one. Several are still present in stale docs (CLASSES.md:78 cites #f0b84a) — that is why this list exists.

shape_carriers.note: The four shape-only bright carriers survive the reset (docs/art/hero-palettes.md §3). With hue gone game-wide, these are load-bearing: they are how the single bright value stays legible as four different things.
